'''Nirauan''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in second of three inner [[Planet/Legends|planets]] in the [[Nirauan system/Legends|Nirauan system]] in [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]. It was inhabited by the indigenous [[Bird/Legends|avian]] [[Qom Jha and Qom Qae]] [[Species/Legends|species]], and was the [[Hand of Thrawn|capital]] of the [[Empire of the Hand]], where it housed a large garrison of [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] and [[Human/Legends|human]] personnel.

==Description==
The second [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] of a weak [[Nirauan's sun|red star]], it was an arboreal world with a landscape of jungle interrupted by small lakes. The Qom Jha and Qom Qae species lived on the world, and while they were [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]], they did not develop a technological culture.

==History==
{{Quote|There's some kind of fortress sitting on a bluff at the far end of the ravine.|[[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]]|<ref name="SotP" />}}
[[File:InfiltratingEC.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] on Nirauan.]]
A former [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] colony of the [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]] in [[Pre-Republic era|Pre-Republic times]],<ref name="TEA" /> the only known point of contact with the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] was the ancient fortress known as the High Tower or [[Hand of Thrawn]]. Built of the same black, energy-absorbing [[Hijarna stone|stone]] as the ancient citadel on [[Hijarna]], and set above a cave system inhabited by Qom Jha and Qom Qae groups, it was a relic of an ancient, long-forgotten war. Damaged and deserted after what appeared to be a [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] strike, the base was eventually reoccupied by forces loyal to [[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]], during or soon after the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The fortress also attracted other Imperials to the world, such as the [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]], whose son [[Jagged Fel|Jagged]] was born on Nirauan.
Thrawn and his forces modified the base with a blend of Chiss and Imperial technology. In this period, the High Tower boasted command facilities comparable to a [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], heavy defensive weaponry, and a hangar stocked with a full wing of TIE scouts. Hidden in the caves beneath the castle were a library computer and a [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo (clone)|clone]] of Thrawn himself, awaiting activation in a [[Spaarti cloning cylinder]].

[[File:CloneThrawn.jpg|thumb|right|100px|A [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] tank in the Hand of Thrawn fortress]]
However, in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] managed to [[Mission to Nirauan|inflict serious damage]] on the base, flooding the library computer, killing the clone, and crashing the ''[[Jade's Fire]]'' into the main hangar.<ref name="VotF" /> Although this damage apparently allowed the [[Cavrilhu Pirates]] to temporarily occupy the base,<ref name="RSBF" /> the defenses were supposed to have been rebuilt by the time the Skywalkers returned to Nirauan three years later - although no surface landing was allowed to verify the claim.

Officially, the High Fortress served as a liaison post between the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] and the [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]], staffed by a small Imperial delegation under [[General/Legends|General]] [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] and a group of Chiss warriors from [[Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo's Household Phalanx]] led by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Kres'ten'tarthi]], [[Core name/Legends|core name]] "Stent". However, given that the primary loyalties of both groups lay with Thrawn, it is believed that the base also played a role as a command hub for the enigmatic [[Empire of the Hand]] and its holdings.<ref name="VotF" />

At some point during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], the Hand of Thrawn was apparently abandoned, although the implications of this event remain unclear.<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|383|Nirauan}}</ref>

At some point between the disappearance of the Empire of the Hand and the beginning of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]], a team of scientists from the [[University of Sanbra]] came to Nirauan to study the remains of the fortress, hoping to learn more about the Chiss.<ref name="TNEGtAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref>
